settings.label: Pause Telegram alerts
settings.description: Master switch. When on, no alerts fire regardless of thresholds.

settings.label: Min ROI %
settings.description: Minimum net ROI (after fees) for an alert.

settings.label: Min profit $
settings.description: Minimum net profit in USD for an alert.

settings.label: Min stake $
settings.description: Minimum executable stake. Filters out tiny-liquidity noise.

settings.label: Cooldown (ms)
settings.description: Per-market cooldown between alerts.

settings.label: Min persistence (s)
settings.description: Arb must survive this long before alerting. Kills phantoms.

settings.label: Poll concurrency
settings.description: Parallel market scans in the poller.

settings.label: Scan timeout (ms)
settings.description: Per-scan hard timeout before abort.

settings.label: Suspicious ROI threshold %
settings.description: SET-003: arbs above this ROI with unknown depth are flagged suspicious and excluded from stats/alerts. Real arbs are usually 1-5%.

settings.label: Watcher: max Kalshi tickers
settings.description: WS-103: HOT-tier cap on live-streamed Kalshi tickers in the WS watcher.

settings.label: Watcher: max PM tokens
settings.description: WS-103: HOT-tier cap on live-streamed Polymarket token IDs in the WS watcher.

settings.label: Watcher: demote after (days)
settings.description: WS-103: HOT pairs with no arb episode within this window score down toward WARM.

settings.label: Pause auto-discovery
settings.description: Stop automatic category scans for new market pairs.

settings.label: Scan interval (h)
settings.description: Hours between auto-discovery category scans.

settings.label: Auto-approve confidence
settings.description: Pairs at or above this confidence are saved automatically (AUTO-001, when implemented).

settings.label: Max markets per scan
settings.description: Cap on markets added by a single discovery scan.

settings.label: Yield bias
settings.description: AUTO-003: how strongly category scans favor categories with realized arb episodes (0 = pure round-robin, 100 = heavily biased). Every category still gets scanned periodically.

settings.label: Auto-retirement
settings.description: Automatically archive expired or dead markets so they stop consuming polling budget.

settings.label: Expiry grace (h)
settings.description: Hours after market expiry before it is archived (allows settlement-window arbs).

settings.label: Dead-market days
settings.description: Archive markets with zero matched outcomes for this many consecutive days.

settings.label: Protect favorites
settings.description: Never auto-archive starred markets.

settings.label: Execution mode
settings.description: Paper simulates orders, live-gated validates but blocks real orders, and live permits explicit manual execution after confirmation.

settings.label: Max stake per trade $
settings.description: Hard cap on a single execution stake.

settings.label: Max daily exposure $
settings.description: Total capital deployable per day across all executions.

settings.label: BotTrader enabled
settings.description: Master switch. When off, no bot trades are placed.

settings.label: Execution mode
settings.description: Paper simulates trades. Production places real orders (requires execute.mode=live).

settings.label: Candidate selection
settings.description: Rank BotTrader candidates by fee-net ROI, APY, or require both in Hybrid mode.

settings.label: Min ROI %
settings.description: Minimum net ROI (after fees) for the bot to trigger a trade.

settings.label: Min APY %
settings.description: Minimum annualized yield. Set to 0 to disable APY filter.

settings.label: Min executable shares per leg
settings.description: Require this many shares at the selected best ask on BOTH legs. Required dollar depth is calculated per leg as ask price × shares (for example, 1 share at 24¢ requires $0.24 depth).

settings.label: Max expiry (days)
settings.description: Skip markets expiring later than this. Set 0 to disable.

settings.label: Max trades per day
settings.description: Hard cap on bot trades per UTC day.

settings.label: Default overview sort
settings.description: Initial sort order in Overview.

settings.label: Hide unmatched by default
settings.description: Overview starts with only matched markets visible.

settings.label: Catalog refresh interval (h)
settings.description: Hours between full refreshes of the Kalshi + Polymarket market catalog.
